title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 36 V, Vout = 12 V, Iout = 25 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 3.69 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.0052 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 25 ns; gate charge Qg = 65 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.85 C/W, RthCS = 0.22 C/W, Ta = 35 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.0078 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0194 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 12.6 uH, output capacitor C = 139 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 5.0 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 50 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 110 C; eta >= 96.0%; fan noise <= 32 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 35 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 15.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 12.01 / 6.01 / 4.2 / 3.0 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 2.26
  HS-2: Rsa = 8.01 / 4.0 / 2.8 / 2.0 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 4.12
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.51 / 2.6 / 1.8 / 1.3 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 7.56
  HS-4: Rsa = 3.8 / 1.8 / 1.25 / 0.9 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 10.67
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.6 / 1.2 / 0.85 / 0.6 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 19.26
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.8 / 0.85 / 0.6 / 0.45 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 25.52

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 30.0], [7.5, 18.0], [12.0, 9.0], [15.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 2.82
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 45.0], [20.0, 27.0], [32.0, 13.5], [40.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 6.30
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 40.0], [35.0, 24.0], [56.1, 12.0], [70.1, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 8.56
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 90.1], [55.1, 54.1], [88.1, 27.0], [110.1, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 13.72
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 110.1], [80.1, 66.1], [128.1, 33.0], [160.2, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 16.72

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
